scope: Two same-kind array/dictionary payload replacements in captured arrays, preserving publication and fallback boundaries.

broad.limits: This gate does not replace allocation, memory and final review acceptance. No production-size or clean-host claims.

memory.limits: Two alternating local observations per case/runtime. Whole-process peak RSS is not retained heap or clean-host speed evidence; review all differences before acceptance.

memory_review.assessment: All six large, unretained array/dictionary target groups reduced mean peak RSS by 4,296,704–4,497,408 bytes (9.78%–11.11%). Small and retained configurations were mixed: 13 groups had positive mean changes, up to 133,120 bytes; the highest mean percentage increase was 0.693%, and the largest individual increase was 368,640 bytes. These increases remain visible and are not established to be noise. Unchanged journal/activation layout, bounded two-handle storage, snapshot tests and non-regressing allocation matrices support accepting this specific optimization. Two local paired observations per group do not establish retained-heap bounds, leak absence, universal memory improvement or clean-host speed.
memory_review.decision: accept bounded pair candidate with explicit local-memory limits
memory_review.limits: No production, platform, retained-heap, leak or clean-host competitive claim.

require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3';require 'fileutils'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);out=o+'/pair-controls';raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(out);FileUtils.mkdir_p(out)
b=File.expand_path('../root-array-v4-2026-10-29',o)
probes={'baseline'=>b+'/task-allocation-probe','candidate'=>o+'/task-allocation-probe'}
binary=o+'/candidate-kujo'
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,identities:(probes.values+[binary,__FILE__]).to_h{|p|[p,Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest]},rows:[],semantics:[]}
save=->{File.write(out+'/report.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 %w[array dictionary].product(%w[pair third scalar mixed read callback error shared fresh],[3,2048],[1,2,16,32]).each do |kind,form,width,calls|
  p=->(n){kind=='array' ? "[#{n}]" : "{\"value\": #{n}}"}; read=kind=='array' ? '[0]' : '["value"]'
  extra=case form
  when 'third';"state[2] = #{p.call('n + 2')}"
  when 'scalar';"state[0] = n state[0] = #{p.call('n')}"
  when 'mixed';"state[0] = #{kind=='array' ? '{"value": n}' : '[n]'} state[0] = #{p.call('n')}"
  when 'read';"let exposed := state assert_equal(exposed[0]#{read}, n) assert_equal(exposed[1]#{read}, n + 1)"
  when 'callback';'observe(n)'
  when 'error';"mut caught := false try { state[999999] = #{p.call('n')} } except e { caught = true } assert(caught)"
  else;'';end
  owner="mut seed := [] mut j := 0 while j < #{width} { seed = push(seed, #{p.call('0')}) j += 1 }\nmut state := seed seed = null\n"
  owner+="let held := state\nexport func old() { return held }\n" if form=='shared'
  owner+="export func snapshot() { return state }\nfunc observe(n) { assert_equal(state[0]#{read}, n) assert_equal(state[1]#{read}, n + 1) }\nexport func edit(n) { state[0] = #{p.call('n')} state[1] = #{p.call('n + 1')} #{extra} return n }\n"
  source="from owner import edit, snapshot#{form=='shared' ? ', old' : ''}\nmut i := 0 while i < #{calls} {\n"
  source+="let saved := snapshot()\n" if form=='fresh'
  source+="assert_equal(edit(i + 1), i + 1)\n"
  source+="assert_equal(saved[0]#{read}, i) if i == 0 { assert_equal(saved[1]#{read}, 0) } else { assert_equal(saved[1]#{read}, i + 1) }\n" if form=='fresh'
  source+="i += 1 }\nlet final := snapshot() assert_equal(len(final), #{width}) assert_equal(final[0]#{read}, #{calls}) assert_equal(final[1]#{read}, #{calls + 1})\nmut j := 2 while j < #{width} { #{form=='third' ? "if j == 2 { assert_equal(final[j]#{read}, #{calls + 2}) } else { assert_equal(final[j]#{read}, 0) }" : "assert_equal(final[j]#{read}, 0)"} j += 1 }\n"
  source+="let saved := old() j = 0 while j < #{width} { assert_equal(saved[j]#{read}, 0) j += 1 }\n" if form=='shared'
  source+="print(\"PAIR CONTROL PASS\")\n"
  d=out+'/'+[kind,form,width,calls].join('-');FileUtils.mkdir_p(d);File.write(d+'/owner.kujo',owner);File.write(d+'/main.kujo',source)
  meta={payload:kind,form:form,width:width,calls:calls,source_sha256:Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(source),module_sha256:Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(owner)}
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   args=[binary,'run',d+'/main.kujo','--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout'];args<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm'
   stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="PAIR CONTROL PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,exit:status.exitstatus)
  end
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   row=meta.merge(mode:mode)
   probes.each do |label,probe|
    args=[probe,mode,d+'/main.kujo'];stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="PAIR CONTROL PASS\n"
    m=stderr.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise stderr unless m
    row[label]={argv:args,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i}
   end
   r[:rows]<<row
  end
  save.call
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==288&&r[:semantics].size==432
 r[:identities].each{|p,h|raise 'Identity drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
 r[:status]='characterized';save.call
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end
